newsitem.title: USA: Fisher Scientific Intl Inc Q4 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Fisher Scientific Intl Inc Q4 oper shr rises.

text.p: NOTE: All share data are fully diluted.
Operating income excludes costs incurred with integration of Curtin Matheson Scientific and Fisons Scientific Equipment. 1996 Q4 net including costs was $12.4 million or $0.60 a share.
1995 Q4 net including nonrecurring and redundant charges was $2.0 million or $0.12 a share.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: All share data are fully diluted.
Operating income excludes costs incurred with integration of Curtin Matheson Scientific and Fisons Scientific Equipment. 1996 net including the costs was $36.8 million or $1.87 a share.
1995 Q4 net including nonrecurring and redundant charges was $3.2 million or $0.19 a share.
